note_title: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程

callouts.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#1
callouts.title: 命题1
callouts.body: 假设$f,g$都是由$\mathbb{R}$到某个Hausdroff的拓扑空间$Y$的连续映射，如果$$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$那么$$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}$$

classification_result.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#1

if_problem.statement_en: Assume $f,g$ are both continuous maps from $\mathbb{R}$ to some Hausdorff topological space $Y$. If $$f(r)=g(r),\forall r \in \mathbb{Q}$$ then $$f(x)=g(x),\forall x \in \mathbb{R}.$$
key_techniques: density of the rational numbers in $\mathbb{R}$
continuity and uniqueness from a dense subset

callouts.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#2
callouts.title: 问题1
callouts.body: 函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续函数，并且满足对任意的正整数$n$,以及任意的实数$x$都有$$f(x)=f(x+\frac{1}{n})$$证明函数$f(x)$是一个常函数。

classification_result.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#2

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that for every positive integer $n$ and every real number $x$, $$f(x)=f\left(x+\frac{1}{n}\right).$$ Prove that $f(x)$ is a constant function.
key_techniques: continuity plus density of rational numbers

callouts.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#3
callouts.title: 问题2
callouts.body: 函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续函数，并且满足对任意的实数$x$都有$$f(x)=f(x+\sqrt{2})=f(x+\sqrt{3})$$证明函数$f(x)$是一个常函数。

classification_result.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#3

if_problem.statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that for every real number $x$, $$f(x)=f(x+\sqrt{2})=f(x+\sqrt{3}).$$ Prove that $f(x)$ is a constant function.
key_techniques: density of the generated additive subgroup
prerequisites: basic irrationality and linear combination arguments

callouts.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#4
callouts.title: 想法
callouts.body: 通常而言，如果问题涉及的对象当中具有某种"平移不变性"，那么启用傅里叶分析的工具是很自然的。因为往往经过傅里叶分析的手段处理以后，较为复杂的诸如加法和卷积运算能转换为乘法的运算。

classification_result.id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#4

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Use Fourier analysis for translation-invariant problems
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When a problem involves translation invariance, Fourier analysis is often a natural tool. After applying Fourier-analytic methods, complicated operations such as addition and convolution are frequently converted into multiplication.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when the main structure of the problem is invariance under shifts or when additive and convolution-type relations are present.
